assessment: This landmark study reports the cryo-EM structure of HOPS, a heterohexameric tether that participates in the fusion of late endosomes, autophagosomes, and AP-3 vesicles with lysosomes. The structure provides a convincing update of earlier, lower-resolution models. Interestingly, the SNARE-binding module is attached to the core of the complex. These results suggest possible mechanisms by which HOPS could catalyze SNARE-dependent fusion.
